disagreement.independent_candidate: SAE 1045 about 4e5 cycles, Al 2024 about 1e4 cycles, and Red Brass is outside the plotted curve so no exact N is source-readable.
disagreement.legacy_candidate: SAE 1045 about 2.5e5 cycles, Al 2024 about 7.7e3 cycles, and Red Brass N below 1e3 cycles.

source_review.finding: The steel and aluminum intersections support only order-of-magnitude graph reads. The Brass curve never approaches 350 MPa in the displayed domain, so an exact cycle count or a claimed below-1e3 bound is not available from the source image.

review_reasoning: The thick raster curve makes approximately 2.5e5 to 4e5 cycles equivalent for SAE 1045 at classroom graph precision.
Approximately 0.8e4 to 1e4 cycles is equivalent for Al 2024.
Red Brass at 350 MPa requires extrapolation outside the drawn curve; the source supports only the explicit out-of-range conclusion.
The independent force result 70.69 kN and the qualitative fatigue-notch conclusion match legacy.
reviewed_exam_answer_ru: При S=350 МПа: SAE 1045 — порядка 3·10^5 циклов; Al 2024 — порядка 10^4 циклов; для Red Brass точное N по данному графику не определяется, поскольку уровень 350 МПа лежит выше всей показанной кривой.
Для d=30 мм и σ_a=100 МПа амплитуда силы F_a≈70,7 кН; отверстие уменьшает долговечность из-за уменьшения нетто-площади и концентрации напряжений.
